member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController
member.summary: Browse events (public) and manage them (Organisers, owner only).

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.GetUpcomingEvents
member.summary: Lists all upcoming events so anyone can browse without logging in.
member.response: Array of upcoming events (today onwards), soonest first.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.GetEvent(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns full detail for one event, including venue/route information and its categories.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.CreateEvent(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.EventRequest)
member.summary: Creates a new event. Organisers only.
member.remarks: Expects { title, description, eventDate (yyyy-MM-dd, not in the past), eventType (Running | Walking | Cycling), venueId }. The logged-in Organiser becomes the event's owner.
member.response: Validation failed, date in the past, or venue does not exist.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.UpdateEvent(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Dtos.EventRequest)
member.summary: Updates an event. Only the Organiser who owns it may do this.
member.remarks: Expects the same body as event creation.
member.response: Validation failed or venue does not exist.
Caller is not an Organiser, or does not own this event.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.DeleteEvent(System.Int32)
member.summary: Deletes an event (and its categories). Only the owning Organiser may do this.
member.response: Caller is not an Organiser, or does not own this event.
The event already has enrolments, so it cannot be deleted.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController
member.summary: Race-day results. Organisers capture them for their own events; Participants view their own.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.CaptureResult(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Dtos.ResultRequest)
member.summary: Captures a result (finish time and position) against an enrolment. Owner of the parent event only.
member.param: The enrolment the result belongs to.
member.remarks: Expects { finishTime (hh:mm:ss), position, status (Finished | DNF | DNS) }. finishTime and position are required when status is "Finished".
member.response: Caller is not an Organiser, or does not own the parent event.
The enrolment was cancelled, or already has a result.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.UpdateResult(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Dtos.ResultRequest)
member.summary: Corrects a captured result. Owner of the parent event only.
member.remarks: Expects { finishTime, position, status }, same rules as capturing a result.
member.response: Caller is not an Organiser, or does not own the parent event.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.GetMyResults
member.summary: Returns the logged-in Participant's personal results across all events.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.GetEventResults(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns the public results list (leaderboard) for an event, best position first.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.UsersController
member.summary: User profiles. Requires a logged-in user.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.UsersController.GetMe
member.summary: Returns the logged-in user's own profile.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.UsersController.UpdateMe(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.UpdateProfileRequest)
member.summary: Updates the logged-in user's own profile (full name and phone number).
member.remarks: Expects { fullName, phoneNumber }. Email and role cannot be changed here.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.UsersController.GetUser(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns a user's public profile. Organisers only (e.g. to view a Participant who enrolled).

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.VenuesController
member.summary: Supporting endpoints (an addition to the Part 1 plan): events reference a venue, so clients need a way to list venues and Organisers need a way to add one.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.VenuesController.GetVenues
member.summary: Lists all venues so a venueId can be chosen when creating an event.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.VenuesController.CreateVenue(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.VenueRequest)
member.summary: Creates a new venue. Organisers only.
member.remarks: Expects { name, addressLine, city, province, latitude, longitude }.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Services.TokenService
member.summary: Issues signed JWTs that carry the user's id and role. The token is the "session": every subsequent request presents it, and the API reads identity and role from it.
